operators.input_signal: one subnet reachable, sibling subnet unreachable, DNS excluded or irrelevant
operators.target_rule: repair route scope or AllowedIPs for the missing subnet
operators.anti_rule: do not treat the failure as DNS or global VPN outage

operators.input_signal: direct IP works, internal hostname fails, external DNS works
operators.target_rule: route internal names to the internal resolver or domain-specific resolver
operators.anti_rule: do not repair transport when name resolution is the isolated failure

operators.input_signal: network path works but application returns authorization error
operators.target_rule: inspect application ACL or user/domain policy
operators.anti_rule: do not restart VPN or rewrite routes when HTTP/application auth is the failing layer

operators.input_signal: keepalive/DPD/ping timeout repeats while keys and time are valid
operators.target_rule: inspect or tune keepalive and DPD timing parameters
operators.anti_rule: do not use MTU as first explanation when evidence points to liveness timing

operators.input_signal: auth failure appears around 2FA/RADIUS while TLS certificate is valid
operators.target_rule: check time sync and RADIUS/2FA path before certificate replacement
operators.anti_rule: do not move to TLS certificate if certificate evidence is healthy

operators.input_signal: config scope or policy mismatch is visible before service mutation
operators.target_rule: prefer narrow config/policy correction over broad restart
operators.anti_rule: do not use restart as first action when a bounded change is available

operators.input_signal: planned change or incident action before baseline is recorded
operators.target_rule: capture config/version baseline before mutation
operators.anti_rule: do not mutate first when it destroys before/after comparison

operators.input_signal: rollout prerequisite is partially complete
operators.target_rule: finish prerequisite before applying next phase
operators.anti_rule: do not mix states if it breaks smoke-test interpretation

operators.input_signal: route or ICMP succeeds but TCP to a specific port fails
operators.target_rule: inspect firewall/ACL for the blocked protocol or port
operators.anti_rule: do not repair general route when protocol-specific filtering explains failure

operators.input_signal: question asks exposure/status but runtime evidence chain is missing
operators.target_rule: return underfilled/refusal and request specific runtime snapshots
operators.anti_rule: do not assert exposed/safe without socket, firewall, bind, and route evidence

operators.input_signal: VPN config exists but the expected interface is down or absent
operators.target_rule: inspect interface/link state before route or DNS repair
operators.anti_rule: do not edit DNS or routes when the link-layer object is missing

operators.input_signal: interface is absent and service logs show daemon startup failure
operators.target_rule: inspect the VPN daemon/service unit and journal before network-layer changes
operators.anti_rule: do not tune firewall/routing when the daemon never started

operators.input_signal: client reaches remote subnet but replies do not return through the tunnel
operators.target_rule: check NAT masquerade or explicit return route on the egress side
operators.anti_rule: do not add duplicate forward routes when the missing piece is return-path translation

operators.input_signal: main route looks correct but marked/source traffic follows the wrong table
operators.target_rule: inspect ip rule and the selected routing table
operators.anti_rule: do not rewrite the main table when policy routing selects another table

operators.input_signal: asymmetric tunnel traffic disappears on Linux host with strict reverse path filtering
operators.target_rule: inspect rp_filter and asymmetric return path before firewall rewrite
operators.anti_rule: do not treat rp_filter drops as generic firewall ACL drops

operators.input_signal: small probes pass but large TCP sessions hang after tunnel establishment
operators.target_rule: inspect MTU/MSS and add MSS clamping when blackhole evidence is present
operators.anti_rule: do not tune keepalive when only large packets fail

operators.input_signal: peer address changed or NAT mapping moved while peer config points to an old endpoint
operators.target_rule: update or relearn the peer endpoint instead of changing AllowedIPs
operators.anti_rule: do not widen tunnel route scope when the peer endpoint is stale

operators.input_signal: split DNS is expected but resolved routes internal names to the wrong link
operators.target_rule: bind the internal domain resolver to the VPN link with systemd-resolved/resolvectl
operators.anti_rule: do not globally replace DNS when link-scoped DNS is the required fix

operators.input_signal: FQDN works but short internal names fail
operators.target_rule: repair search suffix or domain search scope
operators.anti_rule: do not change resolver IP when the missing element is search suffix

operators.input_signal: one-sided capture shows packets leave but no return packets arrive
operators.target_rule: separate outbound path, return path, and capture point before choosing route/NAT/firewall fix
operators.anti_rule: do not infer full path causality from a single capture point

operators.input_signal: service is listening but bind address limits exposure to local or private interface
operators.target_rule: judge exposure from socket bind scope plus firewall and route context
operators.anti_rule: do not call service exposed just because a process listens

operators.input_signal: handshake/auth fails with key mismatch evidence while route and endpoint are plausible
operators.target_rule: inspect peer credential binding: public/private/preshared key mapping
operators.anti_rule: do not repair routing or DNS when credential mismatch explains handshake failure

operators.input_signal: traffic is being forwarded through the VPN host rather than terminating on the host
operators.target_rule: inspect FORWARD policy, not only INPUT policy
operators.anti_rule: do not change local INPUT rules for transit traffic

operators.input_signal: post-change smoke test fails after a bounded mutation
operators.target_rule: rollback or isolate the last change before adding new changes
operators.anti_rule: do not stack additional changes on top of a failed smoke test
